title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - YD-2301 (SEQ-5500)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-5500 (DRYER SYSTEM (YD-2301) SHUTDOWN LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-YD-2301, Revision: Rev.03, Status: Issued for Operation, SIL Level: SIL 2.
Equipment: YD-2301, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-2300-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Outlet temperature HIGH-HIGH (TSHH-2301 > 125 degC, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close Discharge (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T2: Nitrogen purge flow LOW-LOW (FSLL-2302 < 200 kg/h, 2oo3) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close Discharge (EFF-2), Trip (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T3: Inlet chute level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-2303 > 90 %, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T4: Drum speed LOW-LOW (chain slip) (SSLL-2305 < 1 rpm, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T5: Vent O2 HIGH-HIGH (ASHH-2307 > 8 % O2, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close Discharge (EFF-2), Open Min-Flow (EFF-4), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T6: Drive motor overload (MPR-2301 MPR pickup, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close Discharge (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start):
- P1: Nitrogen inerting established (O2 < 5%) (AT-2307, Gate: AND)
- P2: Steam condensate drain open (ZSO-2304, Gate: AND)
- P3: Lube oil to gearbox OK (PSL-2306, Gate: AND)
- P4: No active trip / reset done (DCS reset, Gate: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START YD-2301 ENABLED (—, Gate: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-2301, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-YD-2301.

title: One Point Lesson - Nitrogen Inerting Before Steam-On (OPL-YD-2301-01)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-YD-2301-01 - Nitrogen Inerting Before Steam-On.

Equipment: YD-2301, Discipline: Process / Operations, Area: 2300 – POWDER DRYING SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-5500 (SIL 2), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-2301.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
Nitrogen inerting before steam-on for YD-2301 (POLYMER FLUID BED DRYER) in the POWDER DRYING SYSTEM. Polymer powder + oxygen + heat can cause a dust explosion. The dryer must be fully inerted before any steam is admitted.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Obtain the correct operating permit and brief the shift team before the task.
- Precaution 2: Confirm hazardous fluids are isolated / inerted as required by procedure.
- Precaution 3: Beware of flammable, hot, or high-pressure fluids; wear the correct PPE.
- Precaution 4: Never defeat a safety interlock or trip without an authorised override permit.
- Precaution 5: Have emergency actions and communications ready before starting.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Operating procedure & P&ID
- Tool 2: Radio / communication with panel
- Tool 3: Gas detector (O2 / LEL) as required
- Tool 4: Correct PPE for the fluid handled
- Tool 5: Sample containers & PPE for sampling
- Tool 6: Permit-to-work documentation

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Start the N2 purge and raise FT-2302 flow above 200 kg/h
- Step 1 - Check: Permit valid & briefed
- Step 2 - Action: Confirm the vent O2 analyzer AT-2307 reads below 5 %
- Step 2 - Check: Parameter within limit
- Step 3 - Action: Only then admit steam gradually via TIC-2301 / TV-2301
- Step 3 - Check: Interlock status confirmed
- Step 4 - Action: Never bypass the FSLL-2302 low-flow inert trip to start faster
- Step 4 - Check: Change logged on DCS
- Step 5 - Action: If O2 rises above 8 %, the ASHH-2307 trip will stop steam and drive
- Step 5 - Check: Handover to next shift

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: Steam and powder leaking at YD-2301 discharge gland | Cause: PTFE 4526L gland packing worn beyond service limit | Action: Replaced 8 pcs PTFE 4526L packing, staggered joints, re-nipped after
- Symptom: Minor powder weep at feed-end gland | Cause: PTFE 4505L packing hardened and worn | Action: Renewed 2 pcs PTFE 4505L feed-end packing
- Symptom: Scheduled proof test of dryer outlet high-high temperature trip | Cause: Set-point within tolerance, minor zero drift corrected | Action: Recalibrated TSHH-2301 to 125 degC and function tested to logic

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Polymer powder + oxygen + heat can cause a dust explosion. The dryer must be fully inerted before any steam is admitted.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-5500: e.g. TSHH-2301 trips at > 125 degC - never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and the P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-2301 before working on YD-2301.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.

title: One Point Lesson - Gland Packing Replacement (PTFE 4526L) (OPL-YD-2301-02)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-YD-2301-02 - Gland Packing Replacement (PTFE 4526L).

Equipment: YD-2301, Discipline: Mechanical, Area: 2300 – POWDER DRYING SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-5500 (SIL 2), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-2301.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
Gland packing replacement (ptfe 4526l) for YD-2301 (POLYMER FLUID BED DRYER) in the POWDER DRYING SYSTEM. Worn gland packing lets powder and steam leak at the drum ends. This is the most frequent YD-2301 maintenance job and a housekeeping/safety issue.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Apply LOTO (Lock-Out Tag-Out) and prove zero energy before starting work.
- Precaution 2: Isolate, depressurise, drain and purge the equipment; obtain a valid work permit.
- Precaution 3: Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection.
- Precaution 4: Beware of stored mechanical energy (springs, rotating inertia) and pinch points.
- Precaution 5: Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Standard mechanical hand tools & calibrated torque wrench
- Tool 2: LOTO padlocks and permit
- Tool 3: Laser/dial alignment kit (as applicable)
- Tool 4: Feeler gauges, dial indicator, seal/bearing pullers
- Tool 5: Correct spare parts and gaskets per the BOM
- Tool 6: Lifting gear and slings (certified)

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Isolate steam and N2, drain condensate, and LOTO the drive
- Step 1 - Check: Isolation & LOTO verified
- Step 2 - Action: Remove the old PTFE rings (8 pcs 4526L at discharge, 2 pcs 4505L at feed)
- Step 2 - Check: Parts match BOM / spec
- Step 3 - Action: Fit new rings one at a time, staggering the joints by 90 deg
- Step 3 - Check: Torque / clearance to spec
- Step 4 - Action: Tighten the gland follower evenly - snug only, never over-torque
- Step 4 - Check: No leak / smooth operation
- Step 5 - Action: Warm through slowly and re-check for leaks, re-nip after 24 h
- Step 5 - Check: Record in equipment history

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: Steam and powder leaking at YD-2301 discharge gland | Cause: PTFE 4526L gland packing worn beyond service limit | Action: Replaced 8 pcs PTFE 4526L packing, staggered joints, re-nipped after
- Symptom: Minor powder weep at feed-end gland | Cause: PTFE 4505L packing hardened and worn | Action: Renewed 2 pcs PTFE 4505L feed-end packing
- Symptom: SSLL-2305 speed low alarm, chain slack observed | Cause: Chain elongation with normal wear caused slip | Action: Adjusted take-up, lubricated chain, checked sprocket wear

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Worn gland packing lets powder and steam leak at the drum ends. This is the most frequent YD-2301 maintenance job and a housekeeping/safety issue.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-5500: e.g. TSHH-2301 trips at > 125 degC - never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and the P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-2301 before working on YD-2301.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.

title: One Point Lesson - Controlled Temperature Ramp-Up Procedure (OPL-YD-2301-04)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-YD-2301-04 - Controlled Temperature Ramp-Up Procedure.

Equipment: YD-2301, Discipline: Process / Operations, Area: 2300 – POWDER DRYING SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-5500 (SIL 2), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-2301.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
Controlled temperature ramp-up procedure for YD-2301 (POLYMER FLUID BED DRYER) in the POWDER DRYING SYSTEM. Heating the drum too quickly warps the shell and cracks the steam tubes, causing tube leaks and long downtime.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Obtain the correct operating permit and brief the shift team before the task.
- Precaution 2: Confirm hazardous fluids are isolated / inerted as required by procedure.
- Precaution 3: Beware of flammable, hot, or high-pressure fluids; wear the correct PPE.
- Precaution 4: Never defeat a safety interlock or trip without an authorised override permit.
- Precaution 5: Have emergency actions and communications ready before starting.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Operating procedure & P&ID
- Tool 2: Radio / communication with panel
- Tool 3: Gas detector (O2 / LEL) as required
- Tool 4: Correct PPE for the fluid handled
- Tool 5: Sample containers & PPE for sampling
- Tool 6: Permit-to-work documentation

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Ramp TIC-2301 at a maximum of 10 degC per 10 minutes
- Step 1 - Check: Permit valid & briefed
- Step 2 - Action: Hold at 60 degC to let the drum warm through evenly
- Step 2 - Check: Parameter within limit
- Step 3 - Action: Watch drum thermal growth at the trunnion supports
- Step 3 - Check: Interlock status confirmed
- Step 4 - Action: Reach the 95-110 degC operating band slowly
- Step 4 - Check: Change logged on DCS
- Step 5 - Action: If uneven expansion / rubbing is heard, pause the ramp
- Step 5 - Check: Handover to next shift

- Symptom: Scheduled proof test of dryer outlet high-high temperature trip | Cause: Set-point within tolerance, minor zero drift corrected | Action: Recalibrated TSHH-2301 to 125 degC and function tested to logic

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Heating the drum too quickly warps the shell and cracks the steam tubes, causing tube leaks and long downtime.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-5500: e.g. TSHH-2301 trips at > 125 degC - never defeat it without a permit.

title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - YD-2301
content:

INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- TSHH-2301: Outlet temperature HIGH-HIGH (Temperature Switch) [Setpoint: > 125 degC]. Function: Trip initiator T1 → SEQ-5500. Location: Powder outlet line
- FSLL-2302: Nitrogen purge flow LOW-LOW (Flow Switch) [Setpoint: < 200 kg/h]. Function: Trip initiator T2 → SEQ-5500. Location: N2 purge line
- LSHH-2303: Inlet chute level HIGH-HIGH (Level Switch) [Setpoint: > 90 %]. Function: Trip initiator T3 → SEQ-5500. Location: Powder inlet chute
- SSLL-2305: Drum speed LOW-LOW (chain slip) (Speed Switch) [Setpoint: < 1 rpm]. Function: Trip initiator T4 → SEQ-5500. Location: Drum drive / sprocket
